utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Okay, I think everyone's here. Noor, you're on? I can hear typing but no voice.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Yeah, I'm here. Sorry, was muting something.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: No worries. So, um, the annual plan stuff. We keep circling it and never land anywhere.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Right. Three weeks now.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Which, yeah. Big picture, we want more people paying for the year up front, cash is cash.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Cash is cash until they churn in month two and want a refund.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Sure, sure, we'll get to that. Yuki, you had some thoughts from the weekend?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Um, yeah, a few. I think maybe, if it's okay, I'll start with what I'd put on the table.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Go ahead.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: So, uh, what if we just offered fifteen percent off for anyone who prepays for the full year? Like a flat thing, nothing tiered.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Flat fifteen. Okay.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Why fifteen and not ten? Or twenty? Feels like you picked it off a shelf.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: No, no, I mean, I think there's a reason. Hang on, let me find the sheet.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: While she's looking, did anyone see the email from Davor about the offsite?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Saw it. Didn't read it.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: It's mostly logistics. Dates are the second week of September, I think.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: I thought it was the third week.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Could be. I'll check it.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Okay, got it. So the pilot we ran, the one with the trial accounts, we had about three hundred of them.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: The pilot from March?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: April, I think. Anyway, at fifteen percent, thirty-one percent of those three hundred ended up on annual.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: And, um, the cohort before that, with the old eight percent offer, only got to eighteen percent. So that's quite a jump.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: That's a big gap.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Sure, but was it the same kind of account? Trial users in April could be a different crowd than whoever saw the old offer.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I mean, they came from the same signup flow. I think maybe the mix was close.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Maybe close isn't great.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Fair. I can't prove it was identical.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: The old one ran during the holiday stretch, right?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Mostly, yes. Some of it.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: That might have pulled it down a bit, people are slow then.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Or pushed it up, people have budget to burn in December.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Either way the new number's higher.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Right, that's, yeah, that's kind of the point I keep making. Direction matters more than the decimals.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Direction matters, but if we give away fifteen off and it only shifts people who would've paid annually anyway, we've just cut our revenue.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Um, that's possible. I don't think the data says that though.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: The data's three hundred accounts.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Good enough for a first read.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: For a first read, sure.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Can we, uh, hold that thought a sec. Camille pinged me about the support queue.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: What about it?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: She says the billing tickets doubled last week, and she thinks it's the invoice template change.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: I saw some of those. People confused about the tax line.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Right. Noor, could you look at it with her? Not urgent, just, you know, this week.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Yeah, I can do that. I'll message her after this.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Great. Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Back to the discount. What happens to monthly customers? Do they feel punished?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I think maybe a little, but monthly always costs more. That's kind of what it is.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: They can switch.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Some will switch and then we lose the monthly premium.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Yeah, which is sort of the goal, isn't it? Fewer people churning every month.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Fewer people churning is the goal. Lower revenue per head isn't.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Okay, but net, net, annual is stickier. We've seen that on the older plan.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: We've seen it, I'm not disputing it.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Then what are we arguing.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: I'm checking it's not fluff.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Can I ask something?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Please.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: When someone prepays and then wants out in month four, what do we do? Because that changes how generous we can be.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Um, right now it's prorated, I believe. Klara would know better.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Klara's out till Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Okay. I just didn't want that to be a surprise later.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: No, good flag. We'll sort the refund bit separately.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Fine by me. But that's a real cost.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Everything's a cost.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Not every cost has a number on it.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: This one does. Prorated.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Okay okay. Let's not-

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: I'm just saying-

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: I know. I know. It's useful.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Can I add, I did also check the competitor pages. Most of them sit between ten and twenty on annual.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Which ones?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: The three we usually look at. I can send the links.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Please. Not that I don't believe you.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: No, no, that's fair.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Middle of the range then.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Roughly, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Right. So we're not out on a limb.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Nobody said we were.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Just thinking out loud.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Is the pilot still running for anyone?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: A few accounts got grandfathered. I think maybe forty or so.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Okay. Those would just roll over.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Presumably. I haven't checked how the billing system handles it.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: It'll be fine.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: It'll be fine until it isn't.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Then we fix it.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Let me ask a different thing. Farah mentioned the sales deck still has the old numbers on it.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Which deck?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: The one for the mid-market stuff. I'd guess it's from the spring.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: I can ping her.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: That'd help, thanks. Mateo, just ask her what version she's using.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Will do.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: I still think we're being a little quick, but I don't have a better number.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I mean, if you find a better one, I'd honestly want to see it.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: I'll poke at the cohorts tonight. If something's off I'll say.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Fair enough. Okay, I think that's enough for me. Sana, get the pricing page updated, would you? Maybe by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Yeah. End of the week is fine. I'll need the copy from Yuki.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I can write that up tomorrow, I think. Is a short paragraph okay?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Short is perfect.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Great. And Delphine should see the page before it goes live, she likes to look at anything with prices.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Right, I'll send her a link.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Should I also tell Camille about it? In case customers start writing in?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Yeah, a heads up wouldn't hurt.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Okay, I'll do it when I talk to her about the invoices.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Anything else? I've got a call at the top of the hour.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Petra's coming to the next one, I think, to talk about the roadmap.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Cool. Then I'm off.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Yeah, go. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Okay, um, who's still waiting on the dial-in? Noor, is that you I hear?

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Yeah, it's me. Sorry, it said the host hadn't started.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: My fault, I opened it late. Right, so, where were we from last week-

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Offsite dates. Davor sent the thing again.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Oh, that. Is it actually the second week of September or the third?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Third. Noor said third.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: I think it was the third, yeah. I didn't check, honestly.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Okay, third, I'll go with third. Anyway, that's not even-

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Can I ask who's booking the venue? Because last time it was nobody.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Davor, I assume. Let's, uh, let's not spend the whole call on it.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: I'm not. One question.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Um, sorry, I think maybe I should say, I wrote the pricing page paragraph, it's sitting in the doc.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Great, thanks. Did Delphine see it?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I think she's looking at it today. Maybe tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: I sent her the link Tuesday. She hasn't said anything.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: She never does until the last minute. Fine.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Billing tickets are down, by the way. Camille said it's back to normal.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: It was the tax line. We changed the label and it settled.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Good. Good, that's one fewer thing.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: She did ask if we'd tell support before the page goes live.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Right, yeah, she should know. Okay, so, the thing I actually wanted to get into-

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: The discount.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: The discount, yes. So, um, I had a conversation with finance on Friday. And it's, it's a bit of a wrinkle.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Oh no.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: So they've ruled, as of this month, anything on annual that's above twelve percent has to go to the CFO. Deal by deal.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Deal by deal. For self-serve too?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: That was my question. And the answer was no exceptions. The CFO said it himself, self-serve gets treated the same.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Um, but self-serve is, I mean, there's no deal. It's a checkout page.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: I know. I said that. They said still no.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: So someone signs off on every person who clicks the button.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Basically, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: That's dead then.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Well, hang on, let's- okay. Honestly, with that in place, the fifteen doesn't really work anymore. So I want to put it back on the table.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: The whole thing? Or just the number?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: The whole question. Where we landed last week, I'd like to look again, since the ground moved.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Fair. I'd rather do it now than after we've built the checkout.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Is the pricing page already live?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: No, no, it's in review. Nothing's published.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Okay, good.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Could we just ask the CFO for a blanket thing? One approval for the whole plan?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: I asked. That's what no exceptions meant, I think.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Huh.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I think maybe we could go to twelve? Like twelve flat, right at the line?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Twelve flat's an odd number. Feels like we're hugging the limit.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: It's just, um, it's closest to what we had.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Closest to fifteen, sure. Doesn't mean it's good.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Okay. So, ideas. Didn't someone have the other one, with the lock thing?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Ten percent and the price lock. Two years.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Right, that one. The one from the, uh, the second option in the notes.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Twenty-four months, yes.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Sana, you were skeptical of that one, weren't you?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: I was skeptical of everything. That's my job apparently.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Sana, go on.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Okay, so, thing is, if you think about where list is going. We're putting prices up something like eight percent this year. That's what product said.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Eight? I thought seven.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Eight, roughly. Seven, eight. Doesn't matter.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: So someone locking in for two years is dodging that bump. That's worth way more to them than five more points off today.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: And ten is under twelve, so nobody has to ask the CFO for anything. It just goes through.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Clean.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Um, but does the lock cost us? Like, if we raise prices on everyone else and they're stuck?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: It does, a bit. But they're stuck paying us for two years. That's the trade.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Is the lock only on the plan they bought? Or on add-ons too?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Good question. I'd say the plan, add-ons aside.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Okay. I only asked because someone will ask.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Yeah, no, fair.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Quick one. My lunch is calling. Are we doing the vendor thing after this?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Which vendor thing?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: The analytics renewal. Petra said there was a form.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Oh, right. That's separate. I'll forward it.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Cool.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Sorry, are you saying you're fine with the lock, or-

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Hang on. Let me just make sure I've got the whole picture. Ten with the lock, no CFO, and it lines up with the price bump.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: And it's still above the old eight percent offer, so it's still better than what we had before.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Technically. It's a smaller jump from eight than fifteen was.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Yes, I mean, I think maybe the lock makes up for it.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Okay. I think that's enough. Annual plans get ten percent off with the twenty-four month price lock. That's what we're doing.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Done.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Should I change the paragraph?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Yes, please. Swap out the fifteen. Keep it short.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I'll do it today, I think.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: And I'll move the checkout copy. Delphine will have to see it again.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Tell her it's a different number, she'll get nervous. Just send it.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: I'll let Camille know what changed, so support isn't surprised.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Thanks, Noor.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: What about the sales deck? Farah's still on the old numbers.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: I messaged her last week. She said she'd fix it. Not sure she did.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Can you ask again? Gently.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Sure.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Um, what about the competitor links I promised? I never sent them.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: You did not.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Sorry. I'll send them after this.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Okay. I think we're done. Klara's back, by the way, so the refund question can happen this week.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Good. I still want to know about month four.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Yep. I'll get her to join the next one. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Okay, I think we've got everybody. Noor, can you hear us alright?

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Yeah, loud and clear.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Good. So, um, the pricing page. Where are we with that, Yuki?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I think maybe it's mostly done? I swapped the paragraph on Friday, so it says ten percent and the, um, the lock.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Did you change the headline too? Because last I looked it still said "Save more" with the little fifteen badge.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Oh. The badge. No, I don't think I touched the badge.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: That's a design asset, it's not in the doc.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Right, right. I'll find who owns that.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Design owns it. Just file a ticket.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Okay. I'll do it after this.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: And Delphine, has she seen the new version?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: I sent it Thursday. Nothing back yet.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Classic. Okay, well, we'll chase her tomorrow if we don't hear.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: I can ping her again. Though she'll probably say the same thing she said about the first one.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Which was?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: That she'd look at it. Which, fine.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Is it blocking?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Not for the copy. For going live, yeah, she wants to see anything with a price.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Right, that's the rule. So, we need her by, what, end of this week?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Ideally. I'd say Thursday so there's room.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Okay, Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Um, can I ask about the lock part? On the checkout, how does it show up for someone buying?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Right now it's a line under the price. Something like, your rate holds for two years.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Okay. And is that clear? Because I'd guess people read the big number and skip the rest.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Probably. That's kind of true for everything we write.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I think maybe we could put it in the confirmation email too? So there's a record.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Yeah, do that.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Okay. Should I draft it?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Sure, go ahead, but keep it short. Nobody reads long emails.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Billing needs to store the lock date somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Is that, um, is that a lot of work?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Depends. There's a field on the subscription that might do it. I haven't looked.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Can you look? Just a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: And what happens at month twenty-five? Does it just flip to whatever list is then?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Presumably.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Presumably isn't a billing rule.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: It'll flip to list. I'll write it down.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Okay, but should they get a warning first? A reminder or something?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Legal might want that. In some places you have to tell people before a price goes up.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Right. Right, I'd want to check that with Delphine, actually. Or somebody on her side.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: I'll add it to my note for her.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Is the lock on add-ons? Someone asked me about it in the support channel last week, I forgot to say.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: We said the plan itself, add-ons aside, I think.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Okay. That's what I told them, more or less.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I think maybe it's worth writing that on the page somewhere? Just so it's not a surprise.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: In small print.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Well, maybe not tiny. But smaller, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Fine. Yuki, put a sentence in.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Okay, I will.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Switching topics. The analytics renewal. Petra's form.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Oh, right, I forwarded it. Did you fill it in?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Half. There's a question about seats and I don't know the number.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Um, forty-something? I'd guess forty-five.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: I'll say forty-five and fix it if it's wrong.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Good enough. Petra just needs it by Friday, I think.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Yeah, Friday.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Camille asked if there's a line she can give to support, in case people write in about the new pricing.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: What did you tell her?

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: That I'd ask. Maybe a short note, like three sentences?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I can write that, it's basically the same as the page.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: That would be great. I'd send it over.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Okay. Yuki, you're getting a lot of writing.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: It's fine, I think. It's all the same words.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Speaking of old words, what about the sales deck? Farah.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: I asked again. She said she'd update it, then said she'd update it after the next deal review.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: When's that?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Next week sometime.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: So for a week they're quoting fifteen to prospects.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Not all of them. Some.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Um, hm. Can you ask her to at least put a note on the first slide?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: I can ask. She might say no.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Just ask.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Also, Klara's back, right? I was hoping to hear about the refunds.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: She is. She couldn't make this one, she had a thing.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Okay. Still the month-four question.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll get her on the next one for real this time.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Honestly, the prorated bit could matter more now, with the lock. Someone who gets out after eight months and has the price locked... what do we owe them?

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: That's what I meant. It's different from before.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Hm. Yeah. Let's put that on Klara's list rather than guess today.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: I'm not guessing, I'm just saying it's a gap.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Fair, fair. It's a gap.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Should I write down the question for her? So she has it ahead of time?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: That would help, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Offsite. Anyone know where we're staying?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Davor hasn't said. Third week of September, though, that's confirmed now.

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Good. I had a wedding the second week.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Whose?

utterances.speaker: Mateo
utterances.text: Cousin. Doesn't matter.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: I'll be there for the third week, no problem.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Okay. I need to jump to another call. Yuki, send me the page link when the badge is sorted.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Okay, yes. I'll send it Wednesday, I think.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Great. Thanks, all.
